TASK: Cut and upload additional YouTube Shorts for OpenCode Mobile from EXISTING footage (verified real, do not re-record).

VERIFIED FOOTAGE (in repo ~/workspace/opencode-mobile, git-tracked, untapped — none of this has been cut into a Short before):
- website/public/cua-showcase.mp4 — 174s, richest, likely multiple distinct app flows (connect, sessions, new session, chat/coding, settings, model picker etc.)
- docs/qa/screenshots/cua-connect-flow.mp4 — 64.28s
- docs-site/demo.mp4 — 31.00s
- docs-site/demo.gif — 16.87s (likely same content as demo.mp4, skip if duplicate)
- distribution/demo.gif — 10.00s (too short/likely not standalone-worthy, use only if genuinely distinct)

Already live: https://youtube.com/shorts/SMqgZYqf6ZI (source was an ad-hoc /tmp clip, now gone — don't touch this one).
Known dead/failed prior attempt: youtube.com/shorts/jC6yB57t1Oo returns 404 — ignore in counts, don't reuse.

STEPS
1. `source ~/.env.d/github-dzianisv.env` before any gh/github calls (prior session hit 401 — fix this, don't skip GH work).
2. Inspect each video (ffprobe + extracted frames) to identify distinct, coherent segments (15-60s each) showing different app flows. For cua-showcase.mp4 (174s) expect 2-4 distinct segments; for cua-connect-flow.mp4 (64s) maybe 1-2; for demo.mp4 (31s) maybe 1.
3. Cut segments with ffmpeg (`-ss`/`-t`, re-encode if needed for aspect ratio/vertical framing for Shorts). This is editing existing footage, NOT re-recording — allowed.
4. Save cut clips locally with clear names (e.g. short-02-connect.mp4, short-03-new-session.mp4...).
5. Upload each via vibebrowser-cli, ONE browser tab for entire job:
   `npx -y @vibebrowser/cli --remote wss://relay.api.vibebrowser.app/eb936443-00fc-4e18-9b5b-4b06c02b00d6`
   - List tabs, use/create exactly ONE tab, pass --page-id every command.
   - Go to YouTube Studio upload, upload each clip as a Short, add title+description, publish.
   - Close tab only after ALL uploads done.
6. For each uploaded video: verify via oEmbed — `https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=<url>&format=json` must return 200 + title. Only count/list oEmbed-verified ones.
7. Find and update the "OpenCode Mobile" Notion page (notion_API-post-search "OpenCode Mobile") — add/update a section listing ALL Shorts (existing live one + new ones) with oEmbed-verified titles and URLs. Update/create a Demo Registry note marking which source files/segments have now been used.
8. BE HONEST about count. If only 2-3 distinct new Shorts are genuinely supportable without padding with near-duplicates, ship only that many and say so.

RETURN:
- Honest final count of new Shorts uploaded + why that's the ceiling given the footage.
- Table of all Short URLs (old+new) with oEmbed-verified titles.
- Confirmation Notion page updated.
- Confirmation single browser tab closed at the end.
- Any remaining footage gap needed to reach 10x total.
